title: Yellow Crispy Middle Eastern Peanut Butter Harees
description: A low-glycemic, umami-rich Middle Eastern dish featuring peanut butter and crispy harees, steamed in a leaf wrap, perfect for a light lunch or snack. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with the creaminess of peanut butter.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the harees and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the harees and mix them with peanut butter, olive oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Lay a banana leaf flat and place 1/4 cup of the harees mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the leaf-wrapped harees on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove the harees from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the crispy harees hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
